hints.title: Fixed Array Storage Model
hints.text: Maintain an array of size n initialized to 0 representing free storage units.

hints.title: Contiguous Free Block Search
hints.text: For allocate, scan from left to right counting consecutive free blocks until size is satisfied.

hints.title: Block Deallocation
hints.text: For freeMemory, scan the array, reset blocks matching mID to 0, and return the total count cleared.

hints.title: Memory Allocator Array Simulation Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear scan for contiguous free blocks and memory deallocation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Capacity n <= 1000 and total calls <= 1000 make direct linear scan fast and simple.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) space stores the memory state.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Designs clear linear allocation and freeing procedures.
